raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE Genpact Software Development Engineer
Aug 2023 - Present Noida, India
Designed and deployed scalable microservices in the legacy application using SpringBoot, enhancing backend efficiency by 30% and reducing response times by 40%.
Managed Legacy Application Infrastructure maintained and optimized read and write operations on Linux servers, achieved 25% system performance improvement by optimizing server configurations.
Improved application performance by indexing jobs and optimizing database procedures. Reduced job execution time and eliminated data redundancy by minimizing overlap in job processing.
Automated key application workflows, resulting in 99% faster test cycles and 90% quicker database indexing.
Analyzed system specifications and user requirements; reviewed 100+ test cases and conducted thorough Unit and Integration Testing.
Coforge LTD (NIIT Technologies) Senior Software Engineer
August 2021 - August 2023 Noida, India • Collaborated in a 14-member Agile team, contributing to over 10+ software modules, from requirement analysis
to deployment..
Solved 50+ backend issues using Java and Spring Boot, improving system efficiency and maintainability. • Participated in weekly project reviews, identifying 20%+ delivery bottlenecks and proposing timely resolutions.
Developed 8+ microservices with Spring Boot and Kafka, enhancing system scalability and asynchronous processing.
Resolved 30+ production issues by analyzing logs via JP Log Analyzer, reducing incident resolution time by 40%.
Mentored 5+ junior developers and facilitated onboarding, accelerating ramp-up by 30% and improving team output.
DXC TECHNOLOGIES Associate Professional Product Developer
October 2018 - August 2021 Indore, India
Managed end-to-end project execution, ensuring compliance with cost, resource, time, and quality metrics; delivered 100% on-time project milestones.
Communicated regularly with clients and stakeholders, providing progress updates and resolving issues to align expectations and deliverables.
Worked with the QA team to design and implement 30+ automated test scripts, improving test coverage and reducing manual testing by 60%.
Contributed to a large-scale project for a life insurance client within a 20-member team, using DB2, SQL Server, and WebSphere technologies.
Delivered new features, resolved bugs, and deployed applications in the AWS Cloud, ensuring high availability and performance.
• Handled code versioning and build processes using Git, maintaining consistency across dev, test, and prod
environments.
AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS
Awarded Champ Award twice at DXC Technologies for early project delivery and individual excellence (2020, 2021).
Recognized twice by management for commitment and timely delivery. • Organized college blood camp, led basketball team.

Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, DB2

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Deployment), CI/CD
Concepts: Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, SOLID Principles
